C type declarations from https://github.com/tangosdev/sm64ds-decomp, commit 3b5601ac1ebc6aae732f2557af6eca9d2442055d. Used for independently recompiled C functions with complete local byte equality against Mario Kart DS EUR. Assembly implementations are excluded. Header hashes are pinned in verification/sdk-header-manifest.json; each accepted function records its donor source hash, commit and build flags in verification/sdk-source-proofs.json.
